patch_description: A fundamentally different approach: replace the Kalman+SG pipeline with multi-scale wavelet trend fusion. The signal is decomposed via à trous (stationary) wavelet transform, noise-dominated detail scales are soft-thresholded (Stein-style, robust MAD-scaled) while signal-bearing scales are kept, and the reconstruction is fused with a robust local-linear (Theil–Sen-like) trend estimate. Because à trous wavelets are zero-phase (no group delay at any scale), lag is structurally minimal — no recency-weighted de-lag convolution is needed. Trend-preserving reconstruction with per-scale adaptive thresholds attacks spurious slope reversals (the dominant score limiter) directly, while keeping mid-frequency dynamics for tracking accuracy. Final pass is a predictive local polynomial extrapolation-shifted median smoother (low-order, edge-corrected) to suppress residual churn without phase delay.
